language_unsupported: Language "{value}" is not supported, so English is used (supported languages: {supported}).
opt_audiotag: Enable search using the Audiotag API.
opt_language: Language of everything WerZatSong prints and writes: {supported} (default English).
opt_trim: Trim MP3 files to the specified length (in seconds) before processing.
opt_no_discord: Post nothing on Discord for this run, even when .env has a webhook (all, the same as --no-discord alone). keep-match still sends the "match found" messages, and keep-nomatch the "no match found" ones.
opt_no_prompt: Never stop to ask for anything, for runs nobody is watching: no Discord messages without a webhook, and a mode without its API key does not run.
opt_duration: Set the allowed duration range for MusicBrainz searches (format: "min:max").
opt_extension: Extend MP3 files by the specified number of seconds before MusicBrainz analysis.
opt_folder: The folder of the database to search in Audfprint mode: its path inside the database, or just its name.
opt_threads: Set the number of threads to use for Audfprint processing.
opt_shifts: Query-side audfprint --shifts (1-8). Higher = more robust but slower; default {default}, 2 for a quicker search.
opt_shard_timeout: Minutes one database file may take before its matcher is stopped and the file is reported as failed (default {default}).
opt_resume: Continue an audfprint search that stopped part-way (crash, cancel): only the database files it had not finished are searched, then the results are reported as usual.
opt_merge: Merge the PKLZ files of a folder of the database (named as with --folder) into a few large shards (major speedup), then exit. Pass "" for the whole database.
opt_shard_files: In --merge mode, how many source PKLZ files go into each merged shard (default {default}).
opt_max_dropped: In --merge mode, discard a merged shard that loses more than this % of its hashes to full buckets, keeping its sources as they are (default {default}).

log_legend_title_two:
LEGEND
  Each entry is two lines:
log_legend_title_three:
LEGEND
  Each entry is three lines:
log_legend_format:
[LABEL] <aligned> aligned / <raw> raw (<cons>%) | x<hits> | #<rank> | <source pklz> | offset <t>s
    <matched file name> (<matched file path>)
log_legend_body:
aligned : time-consistent matching hashes: the primary evidence.
            audfprint's docs: more than 5-6 aligned hashes usually means a true match.
  raw     : all hashes the query and reference have in common, before time filtering.
  cons%   : aligned / raw. Random chance stays under ~1%, so even a few percent is meaningful.
  hits    : how many alignment hits the worker reported for this pair (the old "xN").
  rank    : candidate position in audfprint's raw pre-ranking (diagnostic, not confidence).
  offset  : query start relative to the reference, in seconds (negative = query starts earlier).
  LABEL   : VERY STRONG / STRONG / PROBABLE are webhook-worthy; BORDERLINE = review manually;
            NO MATCH = below every threshold, listed for completeness.
log_legend_credits:
Credits : who fingerprinted the pklz the match came from and who suggested its source, each followed by
            where it comes from. The package's credit file (.wzsc) comes first wherever there is one, then
            credits-overrides.tsv, then the Lostwave Fingerprints sheet, used alongside experimental guesses
            from wzs.cosine.club, the built-in lists, file names, database folders and song paths.
            "possibly": only a guess.
            What nobody is known for is left out.
log_credits_sheet_note:
The Lostwave Fingerprints sheet is the main source of the credits, used alongside experimental prediction algorithms: {url}
Wherever a package comes with its own credit file, that file comes first. If a credit looks wrong or is missing, check it on the sheet.

merge_why_it_helps: Why this helps: audfprint must fully load (gunzip + unpickle) every database file on every match run, so hundreds of small PKLZ files pay that cost hundreds of times. A few large shards pay it a few times.
merge_capacity_warning: Every table has the same fixed capacity, and a full bucket drops hashes at random. A merged shard that loses more than {maxDropped}% of its hashes is discarded and its sources are left as they are (--max-dropped to change). Files that already hold millions of hashes each gain nothing from merging: lower --shard-files or merge only folders of small files.
